statement.text: แมวไม่ถ่ายปัสสาวะในกระบะทราย เมื่อกระบะทรายอยู่ห่างจากที่นอนมากกว่า 2 เมตร

translation.text: The cat does not urinate in the litter box when the box is more than 2 meters from its sleeping area.

standpoint.declared_basis: pet owner direct observation, no veterinary or animal-behavior credential

question_human.text_verbatim: ทำไมแมวเยี่ยวไม่เป็นที่

lens_translation.question_readout: Under access relation R = {litter-box-use event, location, distance-from-sleeping-area}, does the observed value z0 (urination location) separate at the threshold distance found?
lens_translation.restriction_provenance: single household, single cat, 14-day direct observation window
lens_translation.access_relation_R: observed urination location vs measured distance
lens_translation.claim_function_Phi_z0: distance-to-litter-box functional relation to in-box vs out-of-box urination

hypothesis_world.text: Cats are less likely to use a litter box placed far from their sleeping/resting area.

licensing_test.result: distance >=2m correlated with 4/5 out-of-box events over 14 days

ai_filled.retained_record_route: AI drafted the observation-log template only

assumed.description: distance is the operative variable rather than a confounded factor (litter substrate, cleaning frequency)

tested.falsifier: If the cat continues urinating outside the box after the box is moved to within 1m of the sleeping area for 14 days, the distance hypothesis is defeated.

open: is distance the true causal variable, or a confound

non_claims: This is not a veterinary diagnosis.
This does not generalize beyond the one observed cat.

responsibility.notes: Founder observed and recorded; AI proposed the distance-hypothesis framing; founder alone signs the claim (FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §2.1b).

ownership.question: human
ownership.notes: the cat question and its hypothesis are the owner's; AI drafted the log template only

operationalization.unit_or_scale: binary per event, count over 14 days

bias_register.description: single household, single cat -- not a random sample of cats
bias_register.mitigation: none applied; scope declared n=1 explicitly

comparison.basis: single-household 14-day observation; no comparable prior case identified to compare against

evidence_strength.notes: evidence bears directly on this household/cat, not read across from a different case
